_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil is real — 0 of 36 windows moved ±2 points — so HOLD is the statistically honest call until either an UP breaker (ETH ETF flows >90, options skew >70, CVD >85) or DOWN breaker (funding <35, exchange reserves spiking) actually prints.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both identify Denial and coiling pressure, but the analyst explicitly calls HOLD while the narrative's forward implication leans toward eventual upside resolution without committing to a direction
next_move.confirmed_if: Score holds 32-38 range with funding stable 45-60 and VIX range-bound 65-75 over next 2-3 12h windows
next_move.invalidated_if: Score breaks below 32 (Panic) with funding <35 and exchange netflow >70; OR score breaks above 39 (Anxiety) with ETH ETF flows >95, options skew >75, and CVD sustaining >90
